page_title: BOL 3-1 MON | Bologna v Monza 18/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+4' Armando Izzo (Monza) has tested the patience of referee Maurizio Mariani and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+2' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) is penalised for a foul. Maurizio Mariani had a clear view and blows his whistle.
90+1' Total attempts – 18:3.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
89' POST! Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes against the left post. What a strike that was!
88' The corner is swung in but Bologna can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
88' Bologna will take a corner kick.
83' Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) commits a rough challenge and Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle for a foul. Monza earn a free kick.
83' Omari Forson (Monza) is flagged for offside.
82' Monza enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
80' Substitution. Omari Forson (Monza) in, Danilo D'Ambrosio out.
80' Here is a change. Stefan Posch is going off and Vincenzo Italiano gives the last tactical orders to Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna).
80' It's time for a substitution. Stefano Sensi (Monza) comes on in place of Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro.
80' Substitution. Jens Odgaard is replaced by Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna).
79' A player from Monza commits a rough challenge. Maurizio Mariani blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Bologna get a free kick.
75' Neat passing move from Monza in order to create new attacking opportunities.

75' Alessandro Bianco (Monza) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Bologna win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
74' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) makes a rough challenge and Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle for a foul.
73' Stefan Posch (Bologna) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
70' Salvatore Bocchetti has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Gianluca Caprari (Monza) replacing Milan Djuric.
70' The substitution is prepared. Kevin Martins (Monza) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Georgios Kyriakopoulos.

69' 3 - 1 Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) meets a perfect cross from Charalampos Lykogiannis deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike into the bottom left corner. The score is 3:1.
67' Daniel Maldini (Monza) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar.
66' Vincenzo Italiano decides to make a substitution. Benjamin Dominguez will be replaced by Dan Ndoye (Bologna).
66' The referee allows time for a substitution. Juan Miranda will be replaced by Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna).
63' Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle. Armando Izzo (Monza) commits a foul after dangerous play.
56' Patrick Ciurria (Monza) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
55' Monza seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
55' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
53' A player from Monza commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
53' Bologna concede a free kick following a bad challenge. There is a free kick near the sideline to Monza.
52' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle for a foul.
49' Maurizio Mariani interrupts the game. One of the players from Bologna won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
46' Vincenzo Italiano makes a switch. Thijs Dallinga is coming on in place of Santiago Castro (Bologna) at the start of the second period.
46' Referee Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Sam Beukema (Bologna) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
45+3' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Bologna.

45+3' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Good work from Bologna as they win a corner.
45+1' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Santiago Castro (Bologna) was quite harsh and Maurizio Mariani didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

45+1' Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom left corner. Stefano Turati guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) takes a cheeky throw-in and sets up a counter-attack for his team.
43' The Monza players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
40' Monza control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
39' Salvatore Bocchetti is forced to make a change. Warren Bondo is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Samuele Vignato (Monza).
37' Warren Bondo (Monza) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
37' Stefan Posch (Bologna) strikes the rebound, but it goes well over the bar.
37' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna).
37' The Bologna players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
36' Maurizio Mariani shows a yellow card to Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) for his blatant foul.

34' 2 - 1 What a beautiful moment! Jens Odgaard (Bologna) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the bottom right corner. Stefano Turati just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 2:1.
31' Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
31' Great teamplay by Bologna as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
28' Monza are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
24' Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Monza) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Maurizio Mariani had an easy-decision to make.

22' 1 - 1 Goal! Riccardo Orsolini clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Santiago Castro (Bologna), who jumps highest and steers a bullet header from the centre of the box into the left side of the goal. Stefano Turati had no chance of stopping that. 1:1.

20' Bologna slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
15' The Bologna players are exchanging some short passes.
13' Maurizio Mariani has a clear sight and sees a foul from Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Monza). It's a free kick to Bologna, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
11' We are about to witness a corner kick, another promising situation.
8' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Bologna.
4' 0 - 1 Goal! Patrick Ciurria plays a long ball to Daniel Maldini (Monza), who cuts inside and unleashes a screamer into the right of the goal. The keeper had no chance. Superb strike! 0:1.
3' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Monza will have the kick-off.
Maurizio Mariani will officiate today.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
